native.bitrate: Ethernet AVB baseline excludes 10 Mbit and half duplex; propose the lowest supported baseline 100 Mbit. Faster Ethernet modes still need actual PHY evidence.
native.payload_bytes: Complete encoded Ethernet data field, including the selected streaming header; not unframed audio sample size. 1500-byte baseline, actual TSpec bound also checked.
native.mtu_bytes: Ethernet data-field baseline maximum 1500; unrelated to AMQP body size or IPv4 fragmentation. No 65535-byte generic Ethernet setting.
native.duplex: Full-duplex Ethernet AVB baseline; no claim about other AVB media or all TSN profiles.
native.queue_policy: Native CBS requirement, not generic FIFO/TAS substitute. No executable AVB schedule/capacity model is registered.
native.sync_method: AVB gPTP requirement; does not assert actual grandmaster, path or clock accuracy.
native.qos_priority: Actual SR-class/PCP mapping, no universal PCP-3 assumption when the stream class is unknown. Class A/B mappings and actual bridge configuration remain distinct.
native.vlan_id: Actual stream VID 1..4094, zero does not select an actual VLAN. OpenAvnu implementation's default VID is not declared as a universal norm default.
native.avb_sr_class: Actual A/B stream class for this explicit baseline; no invented class assignment.
native.avb_measurement_interval_us: A requires 125 us, B 250 us; reservation measurement interval differs from application cycle.
native.avb_stream_id: Eight bytes represented by 16 hex digits; actual talker/stream identity is unknown.
native.avb_max_frame_size_bytes: Advertised maximum MSDU excludes MAC framing but includes stream protocol header; this Ethernet baseline limits it to 1500, not 65535.
native.avb_max_interval_frames: UInt16 maximum frame count per class interval, not packet frequency or queue length; actual positive TSpec value required.
native.avb_idle_slope_bps: Actual reserved CBS rate, bounded by actual link rate; generic percentage cannot substitute for reservations.
native.avb_send_slope_bps: Non-positive CBS decrease rate; must equal idleSlope minus link rate when both are provided.
native.avb_accumulated_latency_ns: UInt32 nanosecond path bound from SRP, not automatic 2 ms/50 ms acceptance or project deadline.
native.avb_as_capable: Actual boolean gPTP port state; blank remains unknown in UI/storage rather than being silently confirmed false.
native.avb_reservation_state: Actual reservation state. A saved selection cannot execute MSRP or certify available resources.
native.avb_stream_rank: Emergency/non-emergency stream rank, separate from three-bit PCP priority.
native.avb_destination_mac: Actual six-byte multicast or locally administered destination; globally administered individual addresses rejected.
native.avb_highest_class_delta_bandwidth_percen: Recommended highest-class deltaBandwidth 75 percent; actual reservations and lower-class budgets remain separate. Configurable recommendation, not fixed application bandwidth.

removed.reserved_bandwidth_percent: Unscoped percentage replaced with native deltaBandwidth proposal and actual CBS idle slope.
removed.rate_limit_bit_s: Generic limiter does not implement stream credit shaping.
removed.retransmission_enabled: Native streamed Ethernet traffic has no generic ARQ delivery guarantee.
removed.retransmission_rate: Generic retry probability does not describe CBS/SRP.
removed.retry_limit: Generic retry count does not describe AVB stream transport.
removed.retransmission_delay_ms: Generic retry delay does not describe AVB stream transport.
removed.gateway_maximum_throughput: Unconfirmed fixed 100 Mbit gateway capability is not actual bridge capacity.
removed.gateway_input_buffer: Unconfirmed generic gateway buffer is not actual AVB bridge storage.
removed.gateway_output_buffer: Unconfirmed generic gateway buffer is not actual AVB bridge storage.
removed.gateway_maximum_routes: Actual bridge forwarding-table capability is unknown.
removed.gateway_maximum_messages_s: Actual bridge frame throughput is unknown.
